answer: A payout is split which means 49% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The cipher schedule is applied in whisper and ocean publishes each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2250 identities would post 3111 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
